title: Austin's Avante Building Buy & New Committees
summary:
*   City leaders approved the purchase and lease agreement for the Avante Building, a significant real estate acquisition.
*   New members were appointed to the Mayor's Committee for Disabled Persons, bolstering community representation.
*   An update on the city's current budget status was presented to the council.
